messages:
samantha: Quick heads-up: scheduling Douglas Labs private dry-run and production cutover on Thu 2026-03-25 22:00 PT (quiet window). Primary change: runtime bump v2.1.3 -> v2.2.0 plus small scheduler tweak. Need final signoff and any last blockers.

samantha: Plan: dry-run at 22:00 (no traffic, smoke only), production cutover at 23:00 (canary 10% for 10m then 50% -> 100%). Artifact: sha abcdef7890. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/douglas-labs-v2.2.0-notes

deploybot: Preflight checks:
• infra-health: OK
• pools: gpu-dedicated-3 ready
• artifact: abcdef7890 available
• ci: green
• active-incidents: none
• kms-access: pending (raj)

raj: KMS verify done. douglas-deploy-sa keys available, rotation window outside our window. :white_check_mark:

alex-ops: Adding infra note: disabling node autoscale and setting min replicas=3 for cutover. Will also freeze image promotions in cluster.

oliver: Confirming service account RBAC and image pull secrets. No infra blockers.

megan-oncall: Oncall thresholds for this cutover: error rate >0.8% sustained 3m OR p95 latency >250ms sustained 5m -> initiate rollback. I'll own the rollback action.

product-lead: We ran the regression eval suite this morning against v2.2.0. There is one low-sev language drift in a niche prompt, documented in the release notes. Product is comfortable to proceed with monitoring flags enabled.

cs-liz: CS note: Douglas ops will be on call. They request we avoid any KMS policy edits during 21:30-00:30 PT. They'll escalate immediately on errors.

securitybot: Security scan: no new critical/high findings. Confirm no extra IAM changes required.

deploybot: Dry-run initiated (smoke only). Smoke logs: 
```
smoke.checks: model-load=OK, health=OK, predict.test=OK
canary.sim: 0 traffic (dry-run)
```

samantha: Dry-run finished clean. Proceeding to schedule production cutover at 23:00 PT per plan unless objection.

alex-ops: Locking autoscaler and disabling cluster autoscaling. Network throttles applied for canary to simulate load.

oliver: Note: KV-cache behavior unchanged. If we need to rollback and kvcache shows mismatch, use snapshot restore 2026-03-25-22:45.

megan-oncall: I'll post live p50/p95/errors every 2m during the canary. Rollback command ready.

product-lead: Approved. Proceed at 23:00. :rocket:

deploybot: Deployment scheduled: start=2026-03-25T23:00:00-07:00 mode=canary(10%) artifact=abcdef7890. Will post stage updates.

samantha: Rollback steps (short):
1) deployctl rollback --env private --tenant douglas --to v2.1.3 --reason "ops/auto"
2) confirm routing and service checks (/health, /model/info)
3) if kvcache corruption: restore-kvcache --tenant douglas --snapshot 2026-03-25-2245
4) create incident and tag @cs-liz @product-lead

megan-oncall: Copy of rollback command: ```deployctl rollback --env private --tenant douglas --to v2.1.3 --initiator megan-oncall```

samantha: If anyone reacts with :x: in the next 45m I will abort and move to postmortem prep.

cs-liz: Customer ops confirmed. Standby and ready to escalate.

raj: All security & KMS checks green. No last-minute items.

oliver: Infra ack. Locking image promotions now.

samantha: Thanks team. I'll flip the schedule to locked and we'll proceed. Post-deploy notes and short RCA template will be posted after window.
